name: CFDCodeBench — Zero-shot
protocol: CFDCodeBench fixed 24 tasks, standard zero-shot, 60-second sandbox timeout, strict execution/accuracy/convergence success.

explanation.en: A task passes only if code executes, normalized MSE is at most 10%, and error falls under spatial and temporal refinement.
explanation.zh: 只有代码可执行、归一化 MSE 不超过 10%，且空间和时间网格加密后误差下降，task 才通过。

summary.en: CFDCodeBench evaluates generation of executable, numerically accurate, convergent CFD and PDE solvers.
summary.zh: CFDCodeBench 评估模型生成可执行、数值准确且具备收敛性的 CFD 与 PDE solver 的能力。

task_format.en: Given a structured PDE specification, the model writes a complete Python solver for each of 24 tasks.
task_format.zh: 模型根据结构化 PDE 规格，为 24 个 task 分别生成完整 Python solver。
